request.description: Creates a pending_review booking for the customer. Required fields: event_id, family_member_ids. Optional: coupon_code. The event must be published, family members must belong to this customer, and coupon_code must match an active, unexpired coupon for the selected event and family member count with remaining usage. Coupon codes are normalized by the API, so casing and surrounding spaces are not important. If the coupon beats the automatic discount, the response snapshots coupon_id, coupon_code, discount_source="coupon", discount_name, discount_amount, and total, and consumes one coupon use for this booking. Rejected or cancelled bookings release that coupon use. If an automatic discount is larger than the coupon, discount_source remains "discount" and coupon_id/coupon_code are null.

request.description: Creates a full-payment schedule when the booking has no payment schedule, or selects an event payment plan when payment_plan_id is provided. Then initiates the requested booking_installment_id, or the next pending installment when omitted/null. For positive balances, returns a pending Thawani payment with checkout_url. If a coupon or discount covered the full balance and total is 0.000, the API settles the installment immediately as a paid manual payment with checkout_url=null; do not open a payment webview in that case. Booking must belong to the customer, be approved, have signed contracts, and the customer profile must be complete.

response.name: 200 OK

item.name: Event Enrollment and Interests
item.description: Event enrollment states are coming_soon, interest_open, booking_open, and booking_closed. Event responses add enrollment_status, enrollment_status_label, can_express_interest, can_book, primary_action, and price_tiers. Interest endpoints are public, rate limited, and idempotent.

request.description: Returns published events currently collecting interest. Each event also returns price_tiers with id, name, position, seat_capacity, remaining_seats, price, and currency. Use can_book/can_express_interest instead of inferring availability from dates or prices.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Creates the interest with 201 or refreshes the existing customer/event interest with 200. Returns 409 with customer_account_required and registration_url when no account matches.
Keeps the audit record and changes its status to withdrawn.

item.name: UChat Store
item.description: Authenticated server-to-server Store API used by UChat. Every request requires the configured Bearer token. Customer-scoped requests use X-WhatsApp-Phone as the trusted identity. Prices, VAT, totals, availability, and ownership are always calculated by the server.

request.description: Returns active categories with published products, available options, SKU, price in baisa, currency, and current availability. The phone header is not used for catalog ownership but is included for a consistent UChat request shape.
Returns one published product by slug, including category and purchasable options. Returns product_not_found when the product is missing or not public.
Resolves the cart owned by the normalized WhatsApp phone and returns its items and current server quote.
Adds or increments an available product option by SKU. Quantity must be from 1 to 99. The response is the refreshed cart and quote.
Replaces the quantity and optional note for the SKU in the current phone-owned cart.
Removes the SKU from the current cart and returns the refreshed cart and quote.

Creates an order from the current cart, reserves tracked inventory, snapshots prices and VAT, and initiates Thawani checkout. Repeating the same Idempotency-Key for the same phone returns the same order. For scheduled pickup use pickup_type=scheduled and provide pickup_at.
Returns or recreates the eligible Thawani checkout for a phone-owned unpaid order. Payment initiation is idempotent.
Returns the newest phone-owned orders, paginated at 20 orders per page.
Returns one order only when its normalized customer phone matches X-WhatsApp-Phone.
